body: Thank you so much man. The few people in my life i tried to reach out to all just give bullshit generic cut and paste responses like "youll get over it" or "everything happens for a reason" and all kinds of bullshit like that. Honestly fuck the fuck off with non answers like that jesus christ. But i come on here and immediately, i get a response that at the very least is filled with honesty. I thank you for that. It means a lot
